items.title: Critical Gaps
items.verbatim_quote: Three capabilities carry ±0.8 uncertainty (the maximum) because public evidence cannot determine utilization: P3C1 Core Automation (3 RPA platforms detected but bot count unknown [URF-02]), P4C1 Data Governance (strategy mature but infrastructure "patchwork" [E-061:F2]), and P4C3 Technology Architecture (MuleSoft absent, legacy platforms detected [E-065:F9]). These three areas are the highest-priority discovery items for the engagement team and also represent Zennify's largest deal opportunity — Data Cloud, MuleSoft, and CRM Analytics directly address all three.
